name: iShares Gold Trust (Ondo Tokenized)
oneLiner: IAUon is Ondo's tokenized iShares Gold Trust exposure, a NAV-style ETF tracker for non-U.S. investors rather than a $1 stablecoin.
collateral: Ondo Global Markets tokenized ETF exposure referencing iShares Gold Trust (IAU), designed to provide economic exposure to the underlying publicly traded ETF through Ondo GM rather than direct ownership of ETF shares
pegMechanism: NAV-style tokenized ETF tracker rather than a $1 peg; subscriptions, redemptions, and market pricing follow the underlying IAU economic exposure through Ondo Global Markets and eligible investor flows

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Ondo Global Markets assets use the Ondo Bridge, which documents LayerZero OFT architecture for GM assets in addition to USDY. Because IAUon is an Ondo GM asset and route accounting depends on that external OFT stack, it is scored as external-lock-mint.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-7 (lead pyusd-paypal)

routes.reviewNote: Native IAUon: MINTER_ROLE enumeration (read 2026-07-20) shows the Ondo GMTokenManager 0x2c158bc456e027b2affccadf1bdbd9f5fc4c5c8c (12,828-byte issuance contract) plus the chain's OndoOFT as the two mint authorities. Ondo Global Markets issues natively on this chain.

Native IAUon: MINTER_ROLE enumeration (read 2026-07-20) shows the Ondo GMTokenManager 0x91f8aff3738825e8eb16fc6f6b1a7a4647bdb299 (12,828-byte issuance contract) plus the chain's OndoOFT as the two mint authorities. Ondo Global Markets issues natively on this chain.

IAUon on Solana shares the Ondo program mint authority PDA 9foMHsSDq7nMg4WPusSz9eY7tyxyukqborA8GyU5cUxD (no SOL account exists at the address — a program-derived mint authority, read 2026-07-20 via Solana RPC); freeze authority 51QVCuHfL1FeNjd8BDeffCKhCcAYoULnVB3yjNhShiuK is Ondo's. DefiLlama attributes Solana IAUon supply to Ondo's cross-chain deployment.

IAUon on HyperEVM is minted solely by the OndoOFT contract 0xce61f9246755cc399fd7f37d6b3478590b75aace (sole MINTER_ROLE member, read 2026-07-20): a 6,152-byte LayerZero OApp with endpoint() = HyperEVM LZ V2 endpoint 0x3a73033c0b1407574c76bdbac67f126f6b4a9aa9 and token() = this deployment.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: IAUon resolves to Yes because it is a centrally issued Ondo GM tokenized ETF product with eligibility restrictions and issuer-controlled subscription, redemption, and transfer infrastructure.

reserves.name: iShares Gold Trust (IAU) economic exposure via Ondo Global Markets collateral accounts
reserves.issuerOrObligor: BlackRock (iShares Gold Trust, IAU) via Ondo Global Markets

reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-5 (lead ylds-figure)
reserveReview.rationale: Ondo identifies IAUon as economic exposure to iShares Gold Trust through Ondo Global Markets. The exposure identity and its failure domains (BlackRock's IAU fund held via Ondo GM collateral accounts) are explicit in the product documentation, but the reviewed materials do not publish a dated, reconciled current share inventory, collateral-account allocation, or custody breakdown, so the reserve remains an explicitly bounded aggregate exposure.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Ondo IAUon product disclosure and Global Markets documentation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current IAU share inventory, collateral-account balances, custody arrangements, and independent reserve reconciliation are not disclosed in the reviewed sources.

nonLinkDispositions.reserveName: iShares Gold Trust (IAU) economic exposure via Ondo Global Markets collateral accounts
nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The direct economic exposure and its failure-domain identity are disclosed, but the current holdings inventory and custody allocation cannot be independently reconciled from the reviewed public materials.

providers.name: Ondo Global Markets collateral accounts (custodian undisclosed in reviewed sources)

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-5 (lead ylds-figure)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: Ondo states that GM token collateral is held through Global Markets accounts, but the reviewed sources do not name the custodian or broker-dealer, account segregation, insolvency treatment, rehypothecation terms, or provider shares for the IAU position.

notices.title: Tokenized ETF exposure
notices.message: Ondo GM Tokens provide economic exposure to the underlying ETF but do not give holders direct rights to hold or receive the underlying ETF shares; eligibility restrictions apply.

mintAuthority.summary: IAUon on Ethereum uses AccessControl: MINTER_ROLE held by GMTokenManager (subscription/redemption engine) and OndoOFT (LayerZero bridge for cross-chain minting). DEFAULT_ADMIN is a TimelockController with no PROPOSER_ROLE members — effectively locking admin changes. BSC follows the same pattern with a separate GMTokenManager and OndoOFT.

controls.label: GMTokenManager (Ethereum) — primary minter
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295025, getRoleMember(MINTER_ROLE, 0) = 0x2c158bc456e027b2affccadf1bdbd9f5fc4c5c8c; Blockscout source: GMTokenManager. This contract handles issuer subscription/redemption minting for Ondo Global Markets.

controls.label: OndoOFT (Ethereum) — LayerZero cross-chain minter
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295025, getRoleMember(MINTER_ROLE, 1) = 0x8ffe0da486a4075e7bbb5763fad4732d41f9667c; Blockscout source: OndoOFT. This contract enables LayerZero-based cross-chain mint/burn for IAUon.

controls.label: IAUon Ethereum DEFAULT_ADMIN TimelockController (no proposers — effectively locked)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295025, getRoleMember(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0) = 0x3715b2154d2ff4c5b027c7a1f734b53f27bc34f1; Blockscout source: TimelockController. getMinDelay() = 7200 seconds (2 hours). PROPOSER_ROLE count = 0 (no proposers). EXECUTOR_ROLE count = 2 (0x2e55b738... and 0xff1621ee...). With zero proposers, no new operations can be proposed, making admin changes effectively impossible through this path.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295025: IAUon (AccessControl ERC20, non-upgradeable). MINTER_ROLE count=2: GMTokenManager (0x2c158b...) + OndoOFT (0x8ffe0d...). DEFAULT_ADMIN = TimelockController (0x3715b2..., 2h delay, 0 proposers — locked). BSC: DEFAULT_ADMIN = 0x8860bbfc... (contract), MINTER_ROLE count=2 (0x91f8aff... GMTokenManager, 0xeb8ceb... OndoOFT). No proxy admin on any deployment. Economic-control evidence reviewed 2026-07-15: Ankura Trust Company receives read-only account access and independently reconciles Ondo Global Markets assets and liabilities on a daily NAV cadence. The underlying IAU registration does not prudentially supervise the BVI token issuer or IAUon product.

sources.label: Ondo Global Markets trust and transparency

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: IAUon is a tokenized fund-security exposure tracking the iShares Gold Trust through Ondo Global Markets, not allocated physical bullion.
